skill.summary: Read and write WordPress.com site content through WordPress.com's hosted MCP server. Thin pass-through to WordPress.com's official MCP; the live tool catalog...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Adds mcporter.json and scripts/install.sh config/install files
- Removes obsolete scripts/invoke.sh
- Updates documentation to reflect direct integration with WordPress.com's hosted MCP server and clarify usage as a pass-through for live tool discovery and calls
- Simplifies required dependencies to just mcporter (removes jq, flock, shasum)
- Revises usage instructions to always discover the live tool catalog from the server, emphasizing server-published schemas and instructions as authoritative
- Adds direct references to WordPress.com's MCP documentation and mcporter config reference
